pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'.

path.description: Directory to search in. Required. There is no implicit default — the model must always state the search root. A relative value (for example '.') resolves against `workdir`; an absolute value needs no `workdir`.

workdir.description: Optional absolute directory on the target daemon's file system used to resolve a relative `path`. Required when `path` is relative; an absolute `path` may omit it, and then results are absolute paths. It is never inherited from a previous call, a session default, or the environment root. Provide an expanded absolute path (no '~', no environment variable placeholders); Windows targets use a drive-rooted or UNC path.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 1000.

timeout_seconds.description: Positive timeout in seconds. Defaults to 60 (1 minute).
